farmToFood.headline: From Farm to Food — in Six Stages
farmToFood.description: Scroll through the full journey below. Every seed, every harvest, every plate is part of one African story.

s1.headline: Seeds of Africa.
s1.description: Sourced from smallholder farms and cooperatives across Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, and Nigeria — maize, cocoa, shea, and indigenous crops like fonio and tiger nuts.

s2.headline: Golden harvest.
s2.description: Hand-picked and mechanically harvested at peak ripeness. Each batch undergoes farm-gate quality grading per Ghana Standards Authority (GSA) protocols.

s3.headline: Modern transformation.
s3.description: HACCP and ISO 22000-certified facilities in the Greater Accra region. Cleaning, sorting, milling, and blending — precision at every step.

s4.headline: Ready for the shelf.
s4.description: Shelf-stable packaging meeting EU, USFDA, and ECOWAS food-safety requirements. Every label tells the origin story of its contents.

s5.headline: Great food.
s5.description: From our kitchens to yours. Jollof spice blends, roasted cocoa nibs, cassava flour — nutritious, culturally rooted ingredients and ready meals.

s6.headline: For the world.
s6.description: Distributed across 24+ markets through Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) corridors and partnerships with EU and North American importers.

about.headerText: At AcresxManna, we are dedicated to feeding the world. We are at the forefront of satisfying the increasing need for safe and wholesome food.
about.originParagraph1: AcresxManna Group is redefining how Africa feeds itself and the world. We are a pan-African agrofood group of company committed to building a reliable, sustainable, and equitable food future. Our model integrates farming, food processing, financing, media, and distribution—ensuring quality and access at every stage of the agrofood value chain. Our collective of companies serves both rural producers and urban consumers, creating value through innovation, integrity, and deep community partnerships. We specialize in blending local knowledge with modern practices to empower smallholder farmers, enhance food security, and deliver authentic African food experiences globally. Whether it's through modern farms, inclusive finance, logistics, or storytelling, our mission is simple: to nourish lives, preserve heritage, and strengthen economies from the ground up.
about.originParagraph2: From the small farms of West Africa to global food markets, AcresxManna Group was born out of a belief that Africa can feed itself—and the world—with dignity and excellence. We started with one goal: to bridge the gap between African agricultural abundance and market accessibility. Along the way, we saw the need for more than just farming. We saw the need for structure, support, and systems that work—from seed to shelf. Today, our brands support farmers with improved practices, offer consumers wholesome food options, and bring the vibrance of African culture to global audiences.

businessFaq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
businessFaq.faq0Question: What types of partnerships do you offer?
businessFaq.faq0Answer: We offer various partnership opportunities including supplier partnerships, distribution agreements, manufacturing collaborations, and investment opportunities. Each is tailored to the specific needs and scale of the partner.
businessFaq.faq1Question: What is your minimum order quantity?
businessFaq.faq1Answer: Minimum order quantities vary by product and market. For retail products, we typically start from 500 units. For bulk commodities and exports, minimum quantities are negotiated based on container capacity and product type.
businessFaq.faq2Answer: Yes, we export to over 24 markets globally through Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) corridors and direct partnerships with EU and North American importers. Our products meet international food safety standards.
businessFaq.faq3Answer: We hold multiple certifications including HACCP, ISO 22000, NAFDAC, SON, and MAN. These certifications ensure our products meet the highest food safety, quality, and regulatory standards across markets.
businessFaq.faq4Question: How do I become a supplier?
businessFaq.faq4Answer: To become a supplier, complete our supplier enquiry form with details about your products, capacity, and certifications. Our procurement team will review your application and contact you within 5 business days for the next steps.
businessFaq.faq5Question: What payment terms do you offer?
businessFaq.faq5Answer: We offer flexible payment terms based on partnership type and order size. Common terms include 30-60 day net payment for established partners, advance payment for new partnerships, and letter of credit for international exports.
businessFaq.faq6Question: Do you provide private label services?
businessFaq.faq6Answer: Yes, we offer private label and white label manufacturing services for select partners. This includes custom formulation, packaging design, and production under your brand name with our quality assurance.
businessFaq.faq7Question: What is your lead time for orders?
businessFaq.faq7Answer: Lead times vary by product: ready products ship within 3-5 business days, custom orders take 2-4 weeks, and large export orders may require 4-8 weeks depending on production scheduling and logistics.
businessFaq.faq8Answer: Yes, we provide product samples for qualified business enquiries. Sample requests can be made through our contact form, and shipping costs may apply depending on location and sample quantity.
businessFaq.faq9Question: What quality control measures do you have?
businessFaq.faq9Answer: We implement rigorous quality control at every stage: farm-gate grading, in-process testing, final product inspection, and pre-shipment verification. Our facilities are equipped with modern testing equipment and follow GMP standards.
businessFaq.faq10Question: Can you handle large volume orders?
businessFaq.faq10Answer: Yes, our facilities are designed for large-scale production with multiple processing lines and ample storage capacity. We can scale production to meet significant volume requirements while maintaining quality standards.
businessFaq.faq11Question: Do you support sustainable farming practices?
businessFaq.faq11Answer: Absolutely. We work closely with farmers to promote sustainable practices including soil conservation, water management, reduced chemical inputs, and biodiversity preservation. Our farming programs include training and certification support.
businessFaq.faq12Question: How do you ensure product safety?
businessFaq.faq12Answer: Product safety is ensured through HACCP-certified processes, regular microbiological testing, proper storage and handling protocols, traceability systems, and compliance with international food safety regulations including USFDA and EU standards.
